tasks_completed.description: Fixed todo color scheme in TodoView.tsx and SidebarTodoView.tsx
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced all theme.colors.typography (non-existent) with theme.colors.text. Completed: green icon + green text + strikethrough. In-progress: #007AFF blue icon + blue text. Pending: theme.colors.text (dark gray) icon + text.
tasks_completed.rationale: theme.colors.typography does not exist in the theme, causing undefined/black text. Color scheme now matches spec: green=completed, blue=in_progress, gray=pending.

tasks_completed.description: Fixed sidebar scroll position preservation in RightSidebar.tsx
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced single SidebarContent renderer with SidebarContentStack that renders all history layers + current layer. Previous layers are hidden (opacity:0, pointerEvents:none, position:absolute) but stay mounted, preserving their ScrollView position. On pop(), the previous layer becomes visible with scroll position intact.
tasks_completed.rationale: When push() saved current data to history, the ScrollView was unmounted and re-created on pop(), losing scroll position. Keeping all layers mounted preserves their internal state.

tasks_completed.description: Show only latest TodoWrite in sidebar agent conversation
tasks_completed.changes: Added filterToLatestTodoWrite() that removes all but the last TodoWrite tool call from the rendered messages. Earlier TodoWrite snapshots are hidden since only the latest state is relevant.
tasks_completed.rationale: When a subagent calls TodoWrite multiple times, each showed its own snapshot. Users want to see only the latest todo state.

tasks_completed.description: Disabled content interaction in sidebar ToolViews
tasks_completed.changes: Removed onContentPress prop from ToolView in ChildToolBlock. Header click (onPress) still works for push navigation. Content body clicks do nothing (safe).
tasks_completed.rationale: onContentPress made content areas clickable but they didn't navigate properly in the sidebar context, causing issues with push().

dev.qa_notes: All 4 bugs fixed. TypeScript compiles with zero errors. Verify in browser: (1) Todo items show correct colors per status, (2) sidebar scroll position preserved on push/pop, (3) only latest TodoWrite shown in agent conversation sidebar, (4) clicking tool content body in sidebar does nothing while header still navigates.
